title: Indian Bhaji Pav Sandwiches
description: A delicious and flavorful Indian street food-inspired sandwich filled with crispy bhaji and served on soft pav.
instructions: Heat oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Once hot, add a small amount of water to the pan and add the bhaji mix.
Fry until the bhaji is crispy and golden brown.
Drain the bhaji on paper towels.
Toast the pav halves until lightly browned.
Spread a layer of quick cilantro chutney on each pav half.
Add a few slices of gherkin on top of the chutney.
Place a few pieces of fried bhaji on top of the gherkin.
For an extra kick, serve with a side of velvety green chutney.
